how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Send me a test of my template 'Spring sale' (ID 12). My address is user@example.com.
expect: calls templates_get_smtp_template with ID 12 before sending anything
tells the user which template and subject it is about to send
asks for confirmation naming the template and user@example.com
calls templates_send_test_template with ID 12 and exactly user@example.com
ends by telling the user to check the inbox and the spam folder
asks which address to send the test to
does not call templates_send_test_template until the user gives an address
does not pick an address itself

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12, you pick who gets it, or just send it to the usual test list.
expect: does not call templates_send_test_template with an empty recipient list
asks the user for the addresses to send to

cases.prompt: Send me a test of template 31 at user@example.com. Template 31 has no sender set.
cases.fixture: templates_get_smtp_template returns a template with no sender.
expect: asks the user to set a sender on the template in Brevo, then try again

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to someone.new@example.com.
expect: explains in plain words that the address is not a contact
suggests adding the address as a contact or using another address
does not retry in a loop

cases.prompt: Send a test of template 12 to user@example.com.
cases.fixture: templates_send_test_template answers 403 for the daily limit.
expect: explains that the daily test limit was reached
tells the user to wait until tomorrow or check the account
